name: 通过制造执行系统的生产工序 (1Y5)
name_en: Production Operations with Manufacturing Execution System (1Y5)
description_en_html:
Overview

This scope item covers the setup of the integration from SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition to Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES).

An MES integrates business and manufacturing processes that help to run efficient, high quality production on the shop floor.

You can use this scope item as an example of how to integrate a local customer shop floor system directly into SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition, giving manufacturing staff a clear overview of production operations and improving analytical capability for the management team. SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition is the system of record for all master data. An MES or a shop floor system is the system of record for all work in progress (WIP) data.

This communication scenario provides end points (inbound and outbound), which are needed to integrate an on-premise third-party MES solution (Manufacturing Execution System) to production operation through ALE IDocs, BAPI, and OData calls.

Key Process Flow

  • Create, schedule, and release production order in the SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition system
  • Create and release production order in a Manufacturing Execution System (MES) or shop floor system
  • Update production order in an MES and send information back to the SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition system
  • Confirm production order in the SAP S/4HANA system

Business Benefits

  • Simplifies the integration of SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition of Manufacturing Execution Systems to Production Operation
description_zh_html:
概览

此范围项目涵盖设置从 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 到制造执行系统 (MES) 的集成。

MES 集成了业务和制造流程，有助于在车间运行高效、高质量的生产。

您可以使用此范围项目作为示例，介绍如何将本地客户车间系统直接集成到 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition，使制造员工能够清晰地了解生产操作并提高管理团队的分析能力。SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 是所有主数据的记录系统。MES 或车间系统是所有在制品 (WIP) 数据的记录系统。

此通信场景提供端点（入站和出站），这些端点是通过 ALE IDoc、BAPI 和 OData 调用将企业预置第三方 MES 解决方案（制造执行系统）集成到生产操作所必需的。

关键流程流

  • 在 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 系统中创建、计划和下达生产订单
  • 在制造执行系统 (MES) 或车间系统中创建并下达生产订单
  • 在 MES 中更新生产订单并将信息发送回 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 系统
  • 在 SAP S/4HANA 系统中确认生产订单

业务优势

  • 简化制造执行系统的 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition 到生产操作的集成
